protocol: Unsupervised per-match clustering evaluated strictly post-hoc via Team_A/Team_B permutation alignment against independently human-verified jersey labels. No ground-truth labels are ever exposed during fitting.
mobilenet_v3_small_ablation_note: Benchmarked separately in Stage B ablation: torchvision MobileNetV3-Small (576-d, ~81 ms/crop CPU) achieved ARI=0.099 (f1_3way=0.529) on Norway vs Wales and ARI=-0.002 (f1_3way=0.383) on Chelsea vs Sunderland because ImageNet representations prioritize pose/shape invariance over kit colour. Rejected on both accuracy and ~100x latency cost.
